headline: Continued review of 13 Youth Climate Action Fund applications to a later virtual meeting.
summary: Members read and scored 13 Youth Climate Action Fund applications but ran out of time to discuss them. A short virtual meeting will review the combined scores. A proposed presentation on MyRWA’s CLEANAIR and Black Earth Compost was tabled for a future meeting.
decisions: Approved the September 9 meeting minutes unanimously.
Continued discussion of YCAF applications to a later virtual meeting after scores are combined.
Tabled the MyRWA CLEANAIR presentation and Black Earth Compost item for a future meeting.

transcript:
# Climate Action & Sustainability Commission Agenda

October 14, 2026 5:30PM City Hall Room 113 215 Pleasant Street Malden, MA 02148

## Roll Call (1 min)

- Councilor Carey McDonald – Present (Virtual)
- Staff Liaison Rebekah McPheeters - Present
- Diego Maldonado\* (Secretary) – Present (Virtual)
- Bob FitzPatrick\* - Present
- Rachel Surrette\* - Present
- Lipin Ji\* - Absent
- Amanda Treat\* (Vice Chair) - Present
- Ricky Ma\* (Chair) – Present
- Julius “JJ” Scott (Youth Member) – Present
- Naomi Yohannes (Youth Member) – Absent

## Minutes to be Approved (4 min)

Commission to approve minutes from September 9 meeting.

- Bob motioned to approve the minutes, Rachel seconded. The commission voted unanimously to approve the minutes.

## Youth Climate Action Fund (YCAF) Application Review (110 min) - Ricky

Overview the YCAF application guidelines and the evaluation rubric.

- Ricky read through the program’s evaluation rubric (which can be found here: https://www.cityofmalden.org/1385/Youth-Climate-Action-Fund-Open-Call)

Read through and individually score the submitted applications.

- A total of 13 applications were submitted.
- Bekah noted that the grant rules are such that a community partner can only sponsor up to 3 projects/applications, but that 5 applications were submitted with Friends of the Malden River as a partner. We have other community partners on standby who can support some of these applications should they move forward.
- Ricky and Amanda read through each application so that commission members could score them against the rubric.

Group discussion.

- There was not sufficient time to discuss after reading and scoring the applications. Ricky collected everyone’s scores, and the group decided to schedule a short, virtual meeting soon to look at the consolidated scores and discuss. Bekah will send out a scheduling poll for this.

## Next Steps (5 min)

Discuss agenda for next meeting.

  - The agenda for the next meeting will be to continue to discuss the YCAF applications.

For future meetings, consider MyRWA’s CLEANAIR presentation, Black Earth Compost

  - This item was tabled for a future meeting.

Confirm date/time for next meeting.

  - To be determined via scheduling poll as noted above.

Share out any upcoming relevant events.

- We are scheduled to present the CASC’s annual report to City Council on Tuesday, 10/20/26. Ricky, Amanda, and Bekah are meeting in advance to prep the presentation. Carey noted that it would be great if all commission members could come. We can plan for 15 minutes of content, and 15 minutes of Q&A. The presentation will be at the top of the City Council meeting.

## Adjournment – 7:30PM

- Diego motioned to adjourn, and Amanda seconded. The meeting was adjourned at 7:35PM.

If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000 Ext. 2005

For instructions on enabling live translated captions in Teams, please visit: www.cityofmalden.org/captions
